entries.from: "1 変換 = 1 行でなければならない"
entries.to: "Each conversion must produce exactly one row."

entries.from: "Backspace で行が出てはならない"
entries.to: "Backspace must not produce a row."

entries.from: "前セッションの nav が漏れている"
entries.to: "Navigation state from the previous session has leaked."

entries.from: "前セッションの abandon が漏れている"
entries.to: "Abandon state from the previous session has leaked."

entries.from: "ショートカットでセッションが始まっている"
entries.to: "A session was started by a shortcut key."

entries.from: "修飾付き ESC で放棄行が出た"
entries.to: "A modified Escape key produced an abandon row."

entries.from: "セッションが不当に閉じられた"
entries.to: "The session was closed improperly."

entries.from: "修飾付き打鍵が dwell を汚している"
entries.to: "A modified keystroke has corrupted the dwell time."

entries.from: "モードを抜けたのにセッションが閉じていない (dwell が伸び続ける)"
entries.to: "The session is still open after leaving the mode (the dwell time would keep growing)."

entries.from: "2 変換が 1 行に合算される (既知の限界)"
entries.to: "Two conversions are merged into one row (a known limitation)."

entries.from: "⚠️ dwell は 2 変換ぶんを覆う。1 変換分と誤読してはならない"
entries.to: "The dwell time spans two conversions and must not be read as one."

entries.from: "打ち切りで行を出してはならない"
entries.to: "A forced termination must not produce a row."

entries.from: "active なのにセッションが無い (不変条件 1 違反)"
entries.to: "Composition is active but no session exists (invariant 1 is violated)."

entries.from: "vk=0x{vk:02X} で拭えていない"
entries.to: "The state was not cleared at vk=0x{vk:02X}."

entries.from: "セッションが無いのに行を出してはならない"
entries.to: "A row must not be produced when there is no session."

entries.from: "回収前の打鍵で放棄フラグが消えている"
entries.to: "The abandon flag was cleared by a keystroke before it was collected."

entries.from: "次の変換の開始で、回収待ちの行が偽装された"
entries.to: "The start of the next conversion has disguised a row that was waiting to be collected."

entries.from: "Space で候補表示になる"
entries.to: "Space opens the candidate window."

entries.from: "セッション途中で行が出てはならない"
entries.to: "A row must not be produced in the middle of a session."

entries.from: "1 本目が出ていない"
entries.to: "The first row was not produced."

entries.from: "2 本目が出ていない"
entries.to: "The second row was not produced."

entries.from: "CloakFold の上限は lib.rs の safety valve より 1 秒以上内側でなければならない"
entries.to: "The CloakFold limit must be at least one second inside the safety limit of the monitoring loop."

entries.from: "ツールチップ・メニュー・フライアウトと同じクラス → 誤検知する"
entries.to: "The window shares its class with tooltips, menus and flyouts, so it would be detected falsely."

entries.from: "全 UWP のホストフレーム → 誤検知する"
entries.to: "The host frame of every UWP application would be detected falsely."

entries.from: "DWM 逐語: cloaked=0 は「cloak されていない」= 描画されている"
entries.to: "By the DWM definition, cloaked=0 means that the window is not cloaked, that is, it is being drawn."

entries.from: "cloaked=1 は DWM が描画していない = 候補は見えていない"
entries.to: "cloaked=1 means that the DWM is not drawing the window, so the candidates are not visible."

entries.from: "★ 即座には終わらせない"
entries.to: "It must not end immediately."

entries.from: "★ dwell は debounce の待ち時間を含めない"
entries.to: "The dwell time excludes the debounce wait."

entries.from: "★ 2 周期がまとめて 1 行 (dwell は最後に消えた時刻まで)"
entries.to: "Two cycles are merged into one row (the dwell time runs to the last disappearance)."

entries.from: "★ 2 個目で Begin は出ない"
entries.to: "The second one does not produce a Begin."

entries.from: "★ まだ空ではない"
entries.to: "It is not empty yet."

entries.from: "⚠️★★★ 打ち切りは forced=true でなければならない (行を出させないため)"
entries.to: "A forced termination must set forced=true so that it produces no row."

entries.from: "★ 上限で必ず解ける"
entries.to: "The limit always releases it."

entries.from: "★ 実測の変換回数と一致しなければならない (得られた dwell: {dwells:?})"
entries.to: "The count must equal the measured number of conversions (dwell times obtained: {dwells:?})."

entries.from: "⚠️ 実データで打ち切りが出てはならない"
entries.to: "A forced termination must not occur on real data."

entries.from: "⚠️ 300ms 未満の行は明滅の取り込みを疑う: {dwells:?}"
entries.to: "A row shorter than 300 ms suggests a captured flicker: {dwells:?}"

entries.from: "★ 採用値では 12 行"
entries.to: "The adopted value yields 12 rows."

entries.from: "⚠️ 400ms では融合が起きるはず (この境界が動いたら FOLD_GAP_MS の根拠を測り直す)"
entries.to: "Merging should occur at 400 ms (if this boundary moves, re-measure the basis of FOLD_GAP_MS)."

entries.from: "★ 何も起きない"
entries.to: "Nothing happens."

entries.from: "A キーは IME モードキーではない"
entries.to: "The A key is not an IME mode key."

entries.from:
"⚠️ かな を Toggle にすると偶数回押下で IME_OPEN が実体と反転する \
             (2026-09-12 実測: その間の変換が ime_shadow から丸ごと欠測した)"
entries.to: "Treating the Kana key as a toggle inverts IME_OPEN relative to the actual state after an even number of presses (measured: the conversions in that interval were missing entirely from ime_shadow)."
